climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation. Its rules allow Tannat, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, along with Petit Manseng, Gros Manseng and Raffiat de Moncade. Some vineyards in Jurançon can make red Béarn, and some in Madiran can make rosé.
